params.name: parameters
params.description: Comma-separated list of parameters, e.g. `airTemp,precipAcc60Min,windSpeed`. A full list of supported parameters and definitions is available through the parameters endpoint.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Start of the time range, in the format `2023-04-30T19:00:00Z`

params.name: endTime
params.description: End of the time range, in the format `2023-04-30T19:00:00Z`. Limited to 1 month per query.

params.name: stationCode
params.description: Comma-separated list of up to 100 DTN station codes, e.g. `YNQXX,CPTR3,KNYC1`. You can request observations for multiple stations at once (maximum 100).

params.name: obsTypes
params.description: Comma-separated list of obsTypes, e.g. `METAR,SYNOP,RWIS,AG` If unspecified, all types are shown.

params.name: onlyGood
params.description: Set to `True` to hide observations that have failed QC. QC flags may not be available for historic data.

params.name: obsProperties
params.description: Set to `True` to view properties such as `qc` flag (result of checks: pass, suspicious or fail), `obsType` (see parameters endpoint documentation) and `isDerived` (True if the value is calculated by us from other parameters e.g. relativeHumidity from dewPoint and airTemp). Properties may not be available for historic data.

params.name: showTags
params.description: Set to `True` to include station tags (such as name and management ID) in the response. When set to `True`, each feature in the response will include a `tags` object containing station metadata. Default is `False` to maintain backward compatibility.

params.name: interval
params.description: Set to `15m` for 15-minute intervals, `1h` for hourly, `24h` for daily, or exclude for all observations received from the station. 15-minute interval data will be calculated on the fly and can only be used with parameters that end in the `15Min` suffix. Daily aggregated data will be calculated on the fly and the definition of 1 day is determined by the startTime. To get data aggregated from midnight to midnight, set the start time to your local midnight (expressed in UTC). Can only be used with parameters that end in the `24Hour` suffix. Data is representative of the 24 hours before the given timestamp. E.g. airTempMax24Hour at 2024-09-10T00:00 is the maximum temperature for the 9th September UTC day.

params.name: gapFill
params.description: Set to `True` to fill gaps in hourly time-series with values from our gridded weather model. Hourly model data is available up to 10 years in the past for all locations and selected parameters. Requires gap-filling scope.

params.name: units
params.description: Set to `us-std` to change units from `si-std` to Imperial Units. Default value is `si-std`

params.name: aggregationTimeLabel
params.description:
Specifies how the timestamp is labeled in the response when using time-aggregated data (e.g., `interval=24h`).

This parameter controls whether the timestamp returned for each data point reflects the start or end of the aggregation window.

Supported values:

`end` (default) - The timestamp represents the end of the aggregation period.

`start` - The timestamp represents the start of the aggregation period.
Note: This parameter is only applicable when interval=24h.

Use this endpoint to get near-real time or historic observations for one or more stations (up to 100 stations per request).

### Finding Stations and Parameters

* Use the `/stations` endpoint to search for and identify stations of interest.
* Use the `/parameters` endpoint to explore available parameters.
* Observation type (`obsType`) descriptions are also listed in the `/stations` documentation.

### Intervals

Control the temporal resolution of the returned data with the `interval` parameter

params.name: by
params.description: Get stations by `radius`|`boundingBox`|`stationCodes`|`tags`

params.name: stationCodes
params.description: Comma-separated list of up to 100 DTN station codes, e.g. `YNQXX,CPTR3,KNYC1`. Supports retrieving metadata for multiple stations at once.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude for radial search in decimal degrees, e.g. `54.85`. Valid range: -90 to 90.

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude for radial search in decimal degrees, e.g. `-0.50`. Valid range: -180 to 180.

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius for radial search in kilometres. If not set, default is `25`.

params.name: minLat
params.description: Minimum latitude for boundingBox search in decimal degrees, e.g. `50.85`. Valid range: -90 to 90.

params.name: maxLat
params.description: Maximum latitude for boundingBox search in decimal degrees, e.g. `54.85`

params.name: minLon
params.description: Minimum longitude for boundingBox search in decimal degrees, e.g. `-1.85`

params.name: maxLon
params.description: Maximum longitude for boundingBox search in decimal degrees, e.g. `0.85`

params.name: obsTypes
params.description: Comma-separated list of obsTypes, e.g. `METAR,SYNOP,RWIS,AG`. If not set, default are `METAR,SYNOP`.

params.name: showTags
params.description: Set to `True` to include station tags (such as name and management ID) in the response. When set to `True`, each feature in the response will include a `tags` object containing station metadata. Default is `False` to maintain backward compatibility.

params.name: showBest
params.description: Set to `True` to rank stations by how representative they are of the entered location. This accounts for elevation differences (measured in meters) between stations.

params.name: tags
params.description: URL encoded json string or a free hand string for wild card search. For multiple tags, they are filtered individually (OR), e.g. `{"icao": "KJFK", "wmo": "3240"}` means you're searching for stations with the ICAO code KJFK **OR** WMO code 3240. For wild card search, results will show what matches your entry.

params.name: isArchived
params.description: Set to `True` to only return stations where data is available older than 1 month.

params.name: archiveCounts
params.description: Set to `True` to view how many historical observations are available per parameter, month, and year for a single stationCode. **Restriction:** When `archiveCounts=True`, you must provide only one stationCode. Multiple stations are not supported with this parameter.
